sources.title: AbrahamPJ/facefusion-mobile-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FaceFusion Mobile — Hexagon NPU context binaries (v0.1.0) Qualcomm QAIRT context binaries for FaceFusion 's default face-swap path, converted to run fully offline on the Hexagon NPU. These are not ONNX models and are not portable. Each file is a compiled graph pinned to a Hexagon architecture, and it will not load on anything else.
